html:
Shows an in-game style tooltip for a mount, fetched from the sermeatball API. Hover over a skill name to read what it does.

Usage 

{{Mount|9002335}}
  • The only parameter is the item ID of the mount.
  • The name, grade, description, skills (with effects) and move speed all come from the API. The icon is the game's own icon of the item (icon_item_NNNN.png, read from aa-classic.com); if that file is not on the wiki, the file named after the mount is used.
  • speed (optional): replaces the move speed from the API, in m/s.
  • float (optional): where the card sits on the page. right or left places it at that side with the text flowing around it, center centres it. Leave it out for a normal card in the flow of the page.

Examples 

{{Mount|9002335|float=right}}
{{Mount|9002317|speed=11.7|float=left}}
  • The data is read from data pages stored on the wiki (Module:Data/Mounts/..., made by sync_wiki_data.py), so the cards load without asking the APIs. A mount that is not stored yet is read live (cooldown, casting time and mana from aa-classic.com, one request per skill) until the script has been run for it.
  • Needs Module:Mount, Module:IconName, Template:Grade, Template:MountSkillRow and Template:Mount/styles.css.

No description.
